title: Always
description: 《Always》描寫一段感情結束後，仍然深愛對方、渴望挽回的痛苦與不捨。歌中的主角因愛人離去而陷入悲傷，過去共同留下的照片與回憶，令他更加難以放下。他承認自己曾經犯錯，也明白對方可能已經開始新的生活，但心中的愛意始終沒有改變。即使看見別人陪伴在她身旁，他仍然希望能再次得到機會，重新建立兩人的幸福。歌曲以「Always」象徵永不消逝的愛與承諾。最終，《Always》傳達的是愛情中的悔恨、執著與永恆的思念：即使無法改變過去，也無法確定未來，真正深刻的感情仍可能長久留在心中，難以忘懷。

vocabulary.usage: 想強調某件事只有一種內容或情況時，使用 nothing but + 名詞。
options: I nothing but to school every day.
His great plan is nothing but a name.
She is nothing but very quickly.
We nothing but our bus tickets at the station.
vocabulary.explanation: nothing but 表示只有；計劃除了名字還沒有內容。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：nothing but 不能代替 go；應說 I go to school every day。
nothing but 表示只有；計劃除了名字還沒有內容。
錯誤：very quickly 是副詞片語，不能直接當這裡的名詞內容。
nothing but 不能代替買票的動詞。

vocabulary.usage: 說明一件事從過去某個時間開始，持續到現在時，常搭配現在完成式。
options: She has been happy since she got her new bike.
I have lived here since three hours.
We since go to the cinema every Friday.
The meeting has lasted since two hours.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：since 後面接過去發生的事情，表示從那時起。
optionExplanations: 正確：since 後面接過去發生的事情，表示從那時起。
錯誤：three hours 是一段時間，應用 for three hours。
since 不能這樣放在主語與動詞之間。
two hours 是時長，應用 for two hours。

vocabulary.usage: 遇到困難而不再繼續，或決定不再做某件事時可以使用。
options: Please give up the window; it is cold.
I give up my password into the login box.
The game was hard, but I did not give up.
We give up to the library by bus.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：遊戲很難，但我沒有放棄。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：關窗戶應說 close the window，不是 give up。
輸入密碼應用 type；give up 表示放棄。
正確：遊戲很難，但我沒有放棄。
錯誤：搭車去圖書館應說 go to the library。

vocabulary.meaning: 本來應該如此；命中注定
vocabulary.usage: 談事情原本應有的樣子，或覺得兩個人特別適合在一起時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「Meant to be」？
options: This ticket is meant to be with a phone yesterday.
I meant to be my video call at six.
My tickets are meant to be at ten dollars yesterday.
They both collect old maps. Perhaps they're meant to be.
vocabulary.explanation: meant to be 在此表示兩人像是天生一對。
optionExplanations: 這個句子沒有完整表達用途或命定關係，時間搭配也不成立。
meant to 後面需要動詞；可以說 meant to join。
票價可說 cost ten dollars；meant to be 無法這樣表示售價。
meant to be 在此表示兩人像是天生一對。

vocabulary.usage: 某件事以前會發生、現在卻不會了，常用 not ... anymore。
options: I do not play that game anymore.
I anymore go to bed at ten.
She is anymore my best friend yesterday.
We anymore a long meeting on Monday.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：表示以前玩，現在不玩了。
optionExplanations: 正確：表示以前玩，現在不玩了。
錯誤：anymore 一般不能像這樣放在主詞與動詞之間。
錯誤：用法和時間都不自然；可說 She is not my best friend anymore。
anymore 是副詞，不能代替開會的動詞。

vocabulary.usage: 某個人或一件事經常出現在自己的想法中時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「On my mind」？
options: I put my phone on my mind to charge it.
That unpaid bill is on my mind again.
She walks on my mind to the shop.
He washed on my mind with soap.
vocabulary.explanation: on my mind 表示一直惦記；這裡擔心未付帳單。
optionExplanations: on my mind 表示心裡惦記；充電需要接上電源。
on my mind 表示一直惦記；這裡擔心未付帳單。
錯誤：on my mind 不是能走路的道路。
錯誤：on my mind 不表示身體部位，也不能這樣搭配 wash。

vocabulary.usage: 離開某個地方時，把物品留在原處，或把過去的事情放下。
options: I left behind my password to make the letters bigger.
She left behind to the bus at eight.
We left behind our song very loudly.
I left my bag behind on the train.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：表示下車時把包包忘在火車上。
optionExplanations: 放大文字應調整字體；leave behind 表示遺留或留下。
錯誤：left behind 不能代替 went 或 took the bus。
錯誤：唱得大聲應說 sang our song loudly。
正確：表示下車時把包包忘在火車上。

vocabulary.usage: 一個笑話、動作或有趣的事讓別人笑出來時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「Make someone laugh」？
options: The teacher made me laugh my train ticket.
My brother makes the password laugh before logging in.
My little brother makes me laugh with his funny faces.
I made my hotel key laugh to open the room.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：弟弟做鬼臉，逗我笑。
optionExplanations: make me laugh 後面不能直接接 my train ticket。
密碼沒有笑的能力；make someone laugh 的對象應是人。
正確：弟弟做鬼臉，逗我笑。
開房門要使用鑰匙；鑰匙不會被逗笑。

vocabulary.usage: 請別人看某個東西，或自己簡單查看時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「Take a look at」？
options: I take a look to my train ticket before boarding.
Can you take a look at my new drawing?
She takes a look at to school by bike.
We took a look at sleeping at nine.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：請別人看一下自己的新畫作。
optionExplanations: take a look at 的介詞是 at，不能用 to。
正確：請別人看一下自己的新畫作。
錯誤：take a look at 後面要接查看的東西，不能直接接 to school。
錯誤：想表達九點睡覺，應說 We went to sleep at nine。

vocabulary.usage: 旅行前整理行李，或把東西收進袋子、箱子時使用。
options: We packed up our clothes before the trip.
I pack up my video call with a loud song.
My brother packs up his password by singing it.
She packed up to happy yesterday.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：出發旅行之前收拾衣服。
optionExplanations: 正確：出發旅行之前收拾衣服。
pack up 表示收拾物品，不能用來結束通話。
密碼可以更改或記下；pack up 無法表達這些動作。
錯誤：pack up 不能接 to happy 來表示變開心。

questions.meaning: 內心受傷、痛苦不堪；字面也指流血
questions.usage: 形容失戀或重大失落帶來的痛苦。歌中使用流血作為感情受傷的比喻。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、正確地使用「bleeding（比喻用法）」？
options: The teacher is bleeding because the exam begins at nine.
After the breakup, he felt as if his heart was bleeding.
My brother is bleeding because his bicycle is yellow.
Our new sofa is bleeding because the room is too cold.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。考試開始的時間不能自然解釋流血；可用 worried。
正確。用「心在流血」比喻分手後的痛苦，不是說真的受傷。
錯誤。黃色腳踏車本身不會造成流血；句子缺少受傷的原因。
錯誤。沙發不會因為房間冷而流血；這不是合理的比喻。
questions.explanation: 正確。用「心在流血」比喻分手後的痛苦，不是說真的受傷。

questions.meaning: 引起、激起（騷動、灰塵、爭議或情緒）
questions.usage: 某件事使舊問題、爭論或灰塵重新出現時使用；歌中指情緒被翻攪起來。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、正確地使用「kick up」？
options: The sudden news kicked up a lot of questions at school.
The singer kicked up her suitcase by reading a map.
Our neighbours kicked up their sandwiches at the meeting.
The small clock kicked up the weather before lunch.
optionExplanations: 正確。突發消息引起不少問題；kick up 可搭配 questions、fuss 或 dust。
錯誤。讀地圖不會使行李箱被「激起」；動作不合語意。
錯誤。這裡不是把三明治「激起」；應使用 brought 或 served。
錯誤。時鐘不能激起天氣；搭配與因果關係不合理。
questions.explanation: 正確。突發消息引起不少問題；kick up 可搭配 questions、fuss 或 dust。

questions.meaning: 被大量……淹沒；深陷於……
questions.usage: 除了真的溺水，也可說被工作、訊息或煩惱壓得喘不過氣。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、正確地使用「drown in」？
options: The chef drowned in a pencil after the dinner rush.
The train drowned in Tuesday before reaching the station.
Our team drowned in applause and put it in the fridge.
I was drowning in emails after my week away.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。鉛筆不是可以讓人淹沒的液體或大量負擔。
錯誤。Tuesday 是星期，不是能把火車淹沒的事物。
錯誤。掌聲可形容為熱烈，但不能放進冰箱；後半句使情境不成立。
正確。用 drowning in emails 比喻電子郵件多到應付不來。
questions.explanation: 正確。用 drowning in emails 比喻電子郵件多到應付不來。

questions.meaning: 不輕易認輸的人；鬥士
questions.usage: 談一個人在困難面前持續努力的性格；未必是拳擊手。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、正確地使用「fighter」？
options: Maya is a fighter; she kept trying after three failures.
That sandwich is a fighter; it costs four dollars.
The lamp is a fighter because it stands near the wall.
My phone is a fighter because it has a blue case.
optionExplanations: 正確。多次失敗仍繼續努力，能自然稱為 a fighter。
錯誤。三明治的售價與「不輕言放棄」無關。
錯誤。燈的位置不代表它有堅韌的性格。
錯誤。手機保護殼的顏色不能說明它是鬥士。
questions.explanation: 正確。多次失敗仍繼續努力，能自然稱為 a fighter。

questions.meaning: 永永遠遠；非常非常久
questions.usage: 用在深情承諾或誇張的玩笑；通常不是精確的時間長度。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、正確地使用「forever and a day」？
options: The bus arrives forever and a day at seven fifteen.
The concert lasted forever and a day: exactly nine minutes.
It felt like forever and a day before the dentist called me.
I bought forever and a day at the bakery on Sunday.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。固定班次應用 at seven fifteen，不能用它表示精確時刻。
錯誤。九分鐘並非漫長等待；exactly 也與誇飾語氣不協調。
正確。等待牙醫叫號感覺特別久，以誇飾方式表達時間漫長。
錯誤。這是時間誇飾片語，不是可以購買的商品。
questions.explanation: 正確。等待牙醫叫號感覺特別久，以誇飾方式表達時間漫長。

questions.meaning: 突然破裂、爆開；突然迸發
questions.usage: 談氣球破掉、管線爆裂或情緒突然爆發時使用。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、正確地使用「burst」？

The soup burst a song when the waiter walked past.
The library burst because its opening hours changed.
He burst his homework by putting it in a drawer.
optionExplanations: 正確。氣球碰到尖枝後突然爆破，符合 burst。
錯誤。湯不會爆出一首歌；物品與動作的搭配不自然。
錯誤。圖書館營業時間改變不表示建築物爆裂。
錯誤。把作業放進抽屜不叫 burst；應說 put away。
questions.explanation: 正確。氣球碰到尖枝後突然爆破，符合 burst。

questions.meaning: 押韻；詞尾發音相同

questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、正確地使用「rhyme」？

The shoes rhyme because they are both the same size.
The clock rhymes with breakfast every morning at eight.
Two maps rhyme because they show the same city.

錯誤。鞋子尺寸相同與語音押韻無關。
錯誤。時鐘與早餐不是這裡可押韻的詞語。
錯誤。地圖顯示同一座城市，不代表兩個字押韻。
questions.explanation: 正確。light 和 night 詞尾發音相同，可用 rhyme。

questions.meaning: 真希望能……；為了……我願付出很多

options: What I'd give to step barefoot on a sharp nail.

What I'd give to wait in line for six hours.
What I'd give to lose my passport before the flight.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。赤腳踩到尖銳釘子通常不是合理的強烈願望。
正確。非常想再見祖母一面，符合強烈願望的語氣。

questions.explanation: 正確。非常想再見祖母一面，符合強烈願望的語氣。

錯誤。票價不是可被手指撥過的材質。

questions.explanation: 正確。獸醫用手指輕輕撥過小狗柔軟的毛。

questions.meaning: 禱告、祈禱；有時帶有臨危求助的語氣
questions.usage: 談宗教祈禱時使用；在口語中也可能是半開玩笑的警告。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、正確地使用「say your prayers」？
options: The chef said his prayers by adding salt to the soup.

正確。營隊學生睡前祈禱，符合片語的基本用法。
錯誤。擦飛機窗戶是清潔，不等於祈禱。
錯誤。查火車時間不構成禱告；只是確認行程。
questions.explanation: 正確。營隊學生睡前祈禱，符合片語的基本用法。

questions.meaning: 動過手腳的骰子；比喻不公平的局面
questions.usage: 形容遊戲遭人操控，或一場競爭從一開始就不公平。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、正確地使用「loaded dice」？
options: The teacher loaded dice with pencils to clean the board.

The museum sold loaded dice because its walls were old.
The winner used loaded dice, so the game was unfair.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。這裡把 loaded 當作放鉛筆進骰子；語意不自然。
錯誤。骰子不適合用來切蛋糕；工具與目的不搭。
錯誤。老牆壁與動手腳的骰子沒有因果關係。
正確。作弊者使用動過手腳的骰子，所以比賽不公平。

questions.word: there's no price I won't pay
questions.meaning: 不惜付出任何代價
questions.usage: 強調達成某件事的決心；不一定指實際付款。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然、正確地使用「there's no price I won't pay」？
options: There's no price I won't pay for a completely free pen.
There's no price I won't pay because the milk is cold.
There's no price I won't pay to protect this old photo.
There's no price I won't pay to make Tuesday disappear.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。免費筆不需要付費，與「不惜代價」的語氣衝突。
錯誤。牛奶很冷與願意付出任何代價缺乏合理連結。
正確。強調為保護珍貴照片願付出很大代價。
錯誤。讓星期二消失並非可合理達成的目標。
questions.explanation: 正確。強調為保護珍貴照片願付出很大代價。

questions.meaning: 虧待、傷害、對不起某人
questions.usage: 談不公平對待或辜負別人時使用；歌中帶有口語否定形式。

options: The coach did me wrong by praising my hard work.

questions.meaning: 表示某個動作此刻正在進行。
questions.usage: 描述眼前正在發生的事情；不一定表示長期習慣。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: The chef is cutting carrots now, so please keep the table clear.
The chef is cutting carrots now, but he has not started and will begin tomorrow.
The chef is cutting carrots now, but there is no chef in the kitchen or anywhere nearby.
The chef is cutting carrots now, so he finished all the work last year.
optionExplanations: 正確：廚師此刻正在切紅蘿蔔，動作與時間一致。
錯誤：尚未開始與 now 正在進行互相矛盾。
錯誤：聲稱廚師正在廚房工作，卻又說完全沒有人。
錯誤：去年完成的工作不能解釋此刻正在切菜。

questions.meaning: 前後呈現實際的反差，而不只是重複意思。
questions.usage: 指出雖有某個情況，卻出現不同於預期的結果。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: The gate is locked, but it is not open.
I have two cats, but I own two cats.
The little shop looks closed, but someone is selling flowers inside.
My glass is empty, but there is nothing in it.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：locked 和 not open 只是重述同一狀態。
錯誤：兩句都在說養了兩隻貓。
正確：看似關門卻仍在賣花，形成真正反差。
錯誤：empty 與 nothing in it 意思相同。

questions.word: can’t + 原形動詞（無法做到）
questions.meaning: 指出能力或條件不足，無法做某事。
questions.usage: 說明不能看見、做到或完成某事時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: The ticket is in tiny print; I can’t read the numbers without my glasses.
The sign is huge and clear, so nobody can read it.

Mia cannot lift the box, so she carries it easily with one finger.
optionExplanations: 正確：字太小、沒有眼鏡，因此讀不到號碼。
錯誤：清楚的大招牌與所有人看不到不相符。
錯誤：架子在腳下通常不會造成拿不到的問題。
錯誤：說搬不動，卻能輕鬆用一根手指搬起。

questions.meaning: 只不過是、除了某件事之外沒有其他。
questions.usage: 想淡化某件事，或強調內容只有一種時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: The empty jar holds nothing but air, but it is full of sweets.
I ate nothing but soup, including three cakes and a pie.
The box has nothing but paper inside; there are no toys or clothes.
The drawer has nothing but pencils, yet it also has five phones.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：說只有空氣，卻又裝滿糖果。
錯誤：除了湯還吃蛋糕和批，與 nothing but 衝突。
正確：盒子裡只有紙，符合限定內容的意思。

questions.cue: nothing but some feelings（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：盒子裡只有紙，符合限定內容的意思。

questions.word: have/has been + V-ing + since + 子句
questions.meaning: 從過去某時開始持續，延續到現在。
questions.usage: 說持續的天氣、等待、練習或其他活動。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: They have been living here since ten years.
I have been waiting since three hours.
She has been painting since tomorrow, and she has already finished yesterday.
The clock has been ringing since six this morning, and it is still ringing.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：ten years 是一段時間，應用 for ten years。
錯誤：three hours 是時間長度，應用 for。
錯誤：since tomorrow 不是過去起點，時間也混亂。
正確：六點開始持續響，到現在仍未停。

questions.meaning: 從過去到現在一直如此。
questions.usage: 強調某個長期身分、態度或習慣仍然成立。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: I have always been a singer, but I only started singing tomorrow.
She has always loved chess, but she learned what chess is five minutes from now.
I have always liked maps, and I still collect them today.
He has always lived here, but this is his first visit to the town.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：將來才開始不能支持一直以來的狀態。
錯誤：未來才認識象棋，無法支持一直喜歡。
正確：以前到現在都喜歡地圖。
錯誤：一直住在這裡與第一次來訪矛盾。
questions.cue: I’ve always been a fighter（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：以前到現在都喜歡地圖。

questions.meaning: 說明缺少某人或某物時會怎樣。
questions.usage: 討論必要條件或欠缺資源所造成的影響時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: Without any water, I watered the flowers with a full bucket of water.
Without batteries, the clock works because the batteries are inside it.
Without a map, we could not find the small village easily.
Without my ticket, I walked straight into the ticket-only show because I had a ticket.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：聲稱完全沒有水，卻又用一整桶水澆花。
錯誤：說沒有電池，卻又說電池裝在裡面。
正確：缺少地圖使找路變困難。
錯誤：說沒票，卻又說自己有票。
questions.cue: without you I give up（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：缺少地圖使找路變困難。

questions.word: be meant to + 原形動詞／be
questions.meaning: 表示應該如此、原本預定如此；有時帶命中注定的語氣。
questions.usage: 描述設計目的、預期安排或理想狀態。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: This door is meant to be kept closed, so the sign says “Leave it open all day.”
This door is meant to be kept closed, so please shut it.
The room is meant to be quiet, so everyone must shout all the time.
The toy is meant to float, so the maker says it was made only to sink.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：應保持關閉卻要求整天打開。
正確：門本應關好，指示與用途一致。
錯誤：安靜的用途與所有人必須喊叫衝突。
錯誤：浮起與只會下沉的設計衝突。
questions.cue: it’s meant to be（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：門本應關好，指示與用途一致。

questions.meaning: 說明自己的推測或不太肯定的看法。
questions.usage: 沒有完全把握、語氣想保持柔和時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: I guess the race is over, although the race has not even started yet and I have no reason to think so.
I guess we lost, because the score shows we won and everyone agrees.
I guess the museum is closed; the lights are off and the doors are locked.
I guess she lives here because I know for certain she lives in another country.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：沒有證據又直接否定判斷，推測不自然。
錯誤：比分顯示勝利，不能支持猜測輸了。
正確：門鎖和燈光提供合理推測依據。
錯誤：已確知她住別國，與此推測相反。
questions.cue: I guess I’m not that good anymore（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：門鎖和燈光提供合理推測依據。

questions.meaning: 以前是某個情況，現在不再如此。
questions.usage: 比較過去與現在，強調情況已改變時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: I do not work at the cinema anymore; I left that job last month.
She is not a child anymore, because she is still only three years old.
The old bridge is not used anymore, but cars still use it every minute.
I do not eat sweets anymore, but I eat sweets for every meal now.
optionExplanations: 正確：上月離職，現在已不在戲院工作。
錯誤：三歲仍是小孩，原因不成立。
錯誤：已不再使用卻每分鐘都有車使用。
錯誤：不再吃糖與每餐都吃互相矛盾。
questions.cue: not that good anymore（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：上月離職，現在已不在戲院工作。

questions.meaning: 表達將來意願、承諾或預測。
questions.usage: 作出承諾或表示決定時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: I will help you move on Saturday, but I promise I will never come.
I will paint the fence tomorrow, but I will not paint it tomorrow or any other day.
I will bring the chairs tomorrow; you can count on me.
I will feed the birds tomorrow, although yesterday is tomorrow.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：同時承諾幫忙和絕不出現。
錯誤：承諾明天油漆，卻又說明天及以後絕不油漆。
正確：清楚承諾明天把椅子帶來。
錯誤：昨天不可能是明天。
questions.cue: I will love you（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：清楚承諾明天把椅子帶來。

questions.word: be there + for someone（在場支持）
questions.meaning: 表示將在場，語境中常含支持和陪伴。
questions.usage: 答應在某場合出現或支持別人時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: I’ll be there when your dance show begins. I already have my seat.
I’ll be there at noon, but I will only arrive after midnight tomorrow.
I’ll be there tonight, because I went there three years ago instead.
I’ll be there for your show, but I will not be anywhere near it and cannot watch.
optionExplanations: 正確：已準備好到場支持對方演出。
錯誤：指定中午到場卻要隔天半夜才到。
錯誤：三年前去過不能代表今晚會到場。
錯誤：承諾到場卻說完全不會靠近。
questions.cue: I’ll be there（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：已準備好到場支持對方演出。

questions.meaning: 某個動作持續到指定時點或事件發生。
questions.usage: 表達持續多久；歌曲 ’til 為 until 的縮寫。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: I will stay until the show starts, so I leave before the doors open.
Keep the oven on until the timer rings, then turn it off.
We will wait until the bus arrives, so we will leave ten minutes before it comes.
She will read until midnight, but she stops at six in the morning before midnight yesterday.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：等到表演開始與開門前離開矛盾。
正確：計時器響時才關烤箱，界線清楚。
錯誤：等到車來與車到之前就離開矛盾。
錯誤：時間安排前後混亂，無法表達終止點。
questions.cue: ’til the stars don’t shine（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：計時器響時才關烤箱，界線清楚。

questions.meaning: 在較大的句子中嵌入「何時／當……時」的內容；需按語境判斷。
questions.usage: 談某事件發生時的情況；歌詞的 when 引出時間情境，並由後一句接續。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: I know that when the bell rings, the show starts, but the show never starts when it rings.
I know that when the show ends, we can clean the room.
I know when the train leaves: it leaves at four, but I have no idea when it leaves.
I know when the shop opens, but it has never opened and has no opening time.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：聲稱鐘聲響時表演開始，卻說表演從不在當時開始。
正確：when 引出表演結束的時間情境，並交代後續行動。
錯誤：明確知道四點卻又說完全不知道。
錯誤：沒有任何營業時間資訊，卻聲稱知道時間。
questions.cue: I know when I die（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：when 引出表演結束的時間情境，並交代後續行動。

questions.meaning: 某人或某事一直被想著。
questions.usage: 談擔憂、思念或一直放在心上的事時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: The match is on my mind, but I have no idea a match exists.
The maths test is on my mind, so I have forgotten there is a test and never think about it.
The song is on my mind, so I do not remember or think of it at all.
My grandma is on my mind today; I keep thinking about her visit.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：完全不知道有比賽，不能說它一直在心上。
錯誤：一直想著與完全沒想到考試矛盾。
錯誤：on my mind 表示常想起，不是全然忘記。
正確：一直想到祖母要來探訪。
questions.cue: You’ll be on my mind（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：一直想到祖母要來探訪。

questions.word: 名詞 + that + 主詞 + 動詞（受詞關係子句）
questions.meaning: 指出被某人做過某事的特定物品。
questions.usage: 辨認物品並補充其來源或過去經歷時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: The hat that you made were lost last winter.
The hat that you made look great on the robot.
The hat that you made looks great on the robot.
The hat that you made it looks great on the robot.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：單數 hat 應搭配 was。
錯誤：主詞 hat 為單數，應用 looks。
正確：that 引出的子句說明是哪頂帽子。
錯誤：已用 that 代表帽子，不要再加 it。
questions.cue: pictures that you left behind（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）

pattern.text: 動詞（後面省掉重複受詞）

questions.explanation: 正確：that 引出的子句說明是哪頂帽子。

questions.meaning: 把同一類事物分成不同組別。
questions.usage: 比較一批物品、人物或經驗中的不同部分。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: Some cups are red and some are blue, but every cup is red and none is blue.
Some guests chose tea, and some chose juice.
Some people came early, and some came early, so the two groups are opposite.
Some of the birds can fly, but none of these birds exist.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：先分成紅藍兩組，又說全部是紅色。
正確：用 some...some... 分別說明兩組客人。
錯誤：兩組都早到，不能用來說明相反情況。
錯誤：不存在的鳥無法支持實際分組。
questions.cue: Some that made us laugh, some that made us cry（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：用 some...some... 分別說明兩組客人。

questions.word: make + 人 + 原形動詞（使役）
questions.meaning: 使某人產生某種行動或反應。
questions.usage: 說笑話、消息或事件帶來的直接反應時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: The joke made us to laugh so loudly.
The clown made everyone laugh, but there were no people and nobody laughed.
The joke made us laughing loudly.
The clown made everyone laugh by wearing two different shoes.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：使役 make 後接原形 laugh，不加 to。
錯誤：說大家笑了，卻又說沒人笑。
錯誤：這個使役結構不是 made us laughing。
正確：小丑滑稽的穿著讓大家笑。
questions.cue: made us laugh（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：小丑滑稽的穿著讓大家笑。

questions.word: make + 人 + have to + 原形動詞
questions.meaning: 某件事迫使某人必須做某事。
questions.usage: 指出外部情況造成責任或必要行動時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: The broken lift made us have to take the stairs, but we used the lift as usual.
The missing key made me have to open the door with the key I had in my hand.
The heavy rain made us have to stay inside, but we stayed outside the whole time.
The broken bridge made us have to use another road.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：電梯壞了卻照常乘搭，結果矛盾。
錯誤：說鑰匙不見了，卻又拿著同一條鑰匙。
錯誤：說必須留室內卻一直留在室外。
正確：橋壞了使大家必須改道。
questions.cue: made you have to say goodbye（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：橋壞了使大家必須改道。

questions.word: What I’d give to + 原形動詞（強烈願望）
questions.meaning: 強調非常希望能做某事；是一種感嘆式表達。
questions.usage: 想表達「如果能……就好了」的強烈願望時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: What I’d give to see the northern lights! I hate the idea and never want to see them.
What I’d give to swim in the sea! I will never go near any water and I have no interest in swimming.
What I’d give to see the northern lights! I have wanted to see them for years.
What I’d give to meet the artist! I do not know who the artist is and do not want to meet anyone.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：強烈渴望與完全不想看相反。
錯誤：從不想游泳，與句型含義衝突。
正確：多年渴望看到極光，符合強烈願望。
錯誤：完全沒有見面意願，不能表達渴求。
questions.cue: What I’d give to run my fingers through your hair（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：多年渴望看到極光，符合強烈願望。

questions.meaning: 表示做前一件事的目的；歌曲中以不定詞片語延續前文。
questions.usage: 說明「為了甚麼」而採取行動時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: We went to the lake to watch the birds.
I carried a map to make the river become a mountain.
I bought a paintbrush to cook the rice on the stove.
I wore gloves to hear the music more clearly.
optionExplanations: 正確：到湖邊是為了看鳥，目的清楚。
錯誤：地圖不能令河流變成山。
錯誤：畫筆不是煮飯的合適工具。
錯誤：戴手套不會令聽力更清楚。
questions.cue: To touch your lips, to hold you near（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：到湖邊是為了看鳥，目的清楚。

questions.meaning: 表示一件事發生時，另一件事也發生。
questions.usage: 說明行動應在甚麼情況或時間進行。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: When the oven rings, I know the cake is ready, but the oven has no timer and no bell.
When the bell rings, the pupils leave the room.
When the lights go out, I turn on my torch, but the lights are still on all day.
When I open the book, I close it and never open it at all.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：沒有響鈴裝置，無法支持這個時間訊號。
正確：鐘聲響起時，學生離開房間。
錯誤：說燈熄卻又說一直亮著。
錯誤：聲稱打開卻說根本沒打開。
questions.cue: When you say your prayers, try to understand（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：鐘聲響起時，學生離開房間。

questions.meaning: 努力嘗試做某事，不保證成功。
questions.usage: 表示要付出努力、可能需要多次嘗試時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: She tried to repair the toy, so she threw it away without touching it.
I will try to build the kite, even if it takes all afternoon.
I try to learn the dance, so I refuse to watch or practise any step.
They tried to reach the top, but they never even started walking or planning.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：沒有動手便丟棄，與嘗試修理不符。
正確：願意花整個下午嘗試做風箏。
錯誤：完全拒絕學習行動，不能支持努力嘗試。
錯誤：連嘗試也沒有開始。
questions.cue: try to understand（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：願意花整個下午嘗試做風箏。

questions.word: have/has + 過去分詞（現在完成式：經驗／結果）
questions.meaning: 過去做過的事與現在的認知相關。
questions.usage: 承認經驗、結果或以往曾經做過某事時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: I have made mistakes before, so I check my work carefully now.
I have made mistakes before, but this is the first time I have ever done anything at all.
We have eaten here before, but this restaurant has never opened.
She has visited the island, but she will be born next year.
optionExplanations: 正確：以前犯過錯，現在會更仔細檢查。
錯誤：先前犯錯與第一次做任何事矛盾。
錯誤：店從未開業，卻說以前來吃過。
錯誤：尚未出生就已造訪，時間不合理。
questions.cue: I’ve made mistakes（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：以前犯過錯，現在會更仔細檢查。

questions.meaning: 某種動作或需求從過去持續到現在。
questions.usage: 描述一直等候、工作、需要或尋找的情況時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: He has been working for two hours, although he has not started and is still asleep.
She has been waiting for the garden to open, and she is still at the gate.
I have been practising since today, but today has not started yet.
They have been looking for the dog, but they have never searched or asked anyone.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：未開始、仍睡覺，與工作兩小時矛盾。
正確：等待從過去延續到仍在門口的現在。
錯誤：今天尚未開始，不能已經從今天持續練習。
錯誤：從未尋找，與一直在找矛盾。
questions.cue: you’ve been needing to hear（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：等待從過去延續到仍在門口的現在。

questions.word: wish + 主詞 + 過去式（不符合現況的願望）
questions.meaning: 希望現在的現實有所不同；歌詞用 was，正式語體亦常用 were。
questions.usage: 表達不可能立刻成真的願望或現實相反的想法時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: I wish I could fly like a bird; I cannot fly.
I wish I knew her name, and I already know it well.
I wish I was taller, because I am the tallest person in the world and love my height.
I wish I were home, and I am already sitting at home happily.
optionExplanations: 正確：不能飛卻希望可以飛，符合反事實願望。
錯誤：已知道名字，與希望知道衝突。
錯誤：已滿意自己的身高，並無需要改變的願望。
錯誤：已經在家，與希望身在家中的反事實語境衝突。
questions.cue: I’ll wish I was him（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：不能飛卻希望可以飛，符合反事實願望。

questions.meaning: 指出前句想法或行動背後的原因。
questions.usage: 回答為甚麼，或補充決定的理由。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: We moved the picnic inside because the rain was getting heavy.
The guard put on a coat because the air was very hot and he wanted to be cooler.
I closed the window because I wanted more cold wind to come in.
She drank water because she wanted to be more thirsty.
optionExplanations: 正確：雨勢增強解釋了為何把野餐移到室內。
錯誤：天熱想降溫一般不會因此穿大衣。
錯誤：關窗通常會減少冷風吹入。
錯誤：喝水不能合理支持更口渴的目的。
questions.cue: ’cause those words are mine（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：雨勢增強解釋了為何把野餐移到室內。

questions.word: if + 過去式，could + 原形動詞（假設能力）
questions.meaning: 假設某條件出現，自己便有能力做某事。
questions.usage: 談未必真實的請求或情況，表達能否做到時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: If I had a bicycle, I could fly to the moon without air.
If I had a ladder, I could reach the high shelf.
If I had a ladder, I could reach the high shelf, but the shelf is under my shoe and the ladder cannot help.
If I knew the code, I could open the lock, but this lock has no code and is already open.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：單車不能讓人飛到月球。
正確：假如有梯子，就可能拿到高架上的物品。
錯誤：架子在鞋下，梯子與目的沒有關聯。
錯誤：鎖根本不用密碼且已打開，條件沒有作用。
questions.cue: If you told me to cry for you（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：假如有梯子，就可能拿到高架上的物品。

questions.word: if + 過去式，would + 原形動詞（假設意願）
questions.meaning: 假設某種情況發生，說明自己會如何回應。
questions.usage: 談未確定的情況與預想選擇時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: If I had a free afternoon, I would go climbing, but I hate climbing and never want to go.
If I felt tired, I would go running all night to get more sleep at once.
If it rained, I would put my paper outside so it would stay dry.
If I found a lost wallet, I would take it to the office.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：強烈不想爬山與假設選擇衝突。
錯誤：跑整夜不是立即睡更多的合理方法。
錯誤：下雨把紙放室外不會使其保持乾燥。
正確：假設撿到錢包，會把它交到辦公室。
questions.cue: If you told me to die for you（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：假設撿到錢包，會把它交到辦公室。

questions.meaning: 用助動詞代替前面已明確提過的動作。
questions.usage: 簡短回答或在相連句子避免重複時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: Could you help me? Yes, I could yesterday, but I cannot help now.
Would you join us? I would, but I have already said I will never join under any condition.
If you asked me to sing, I would, but by would I mean I will not sing.
If I had more time, I could. “Could what?” “Finish the model we just discussed.”
optionExplanations: 錯誤：問現在能否幫忙，卻只回答昨天能。
錯誤：願意加入與聲稱任何情況都不加入矛盾。
錯誤：would 在此意為假設下願意唱，不是拒絕。
正確：could 代替前面已談及的完成模型動作。
questions.cue: I could（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）

pattern.text: I could / I would（省去重複動詞）

questions.explanation: 正確：could 代替前面已談及的完成模型動作。

questions.word: there is no + 名詞 + (that) + 主詞 + won’t + 動詞
questions.meaning: 雙重否定語意形成「任何代價都願付」的強烈意思。
questions.usage: 表示沒有例外、沒有哪個選項會被拒絕時；須小心否定範圍。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: There is no road I won’t take, but I will only travel on one road in every situation.
There is no song I won’t learn for the show; I am ready to practise any of them.
There is no book I won’t read, but I have a long list of books I will never open.
There is no job I won’t try, so I refuse to try every single job.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：任何路都願走與只走一條路衝突。
正確：願意練任何歌曲，表達沒有例外。
錯誤：甚麼書都願讀，與有大量絕不讀的書矛盾。
錯誤：沒有一份工作不願試，與全部拒試矛盾。
questions.cue: There’s no price I won’t pay（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）

pattern.text: 省略 that 的限定子句（I won’t...）

questions.explanation: 正確：願意練任何歌曲，表達沒有例外。

questions.word: there ain’t no + 名詞（歌詞非標準否定）
questions.meaning: 在某些口語或歌詞中表示完全沒有；不是正式英文的標準否定寫法。
questions.usage: 欣賞歌詞口語語氣時辨認；正式寫作可改用 there is no。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: The singer says “There ain’t no food,” meaning there is no food in the kitchen.
The singer says “There ain’t no food,” meaning food will arrive next year but is here now.
The singer says “There ain’t no food,” meaning there are two chefs dancing.
The singer says “There ain’t no food,” meaning the kitchen is full of food.
optionExplanations: 正確：口語雙重否定在此表示完全沒有食物。
錯誤：把「現在沒有」扭曲成「現在有」。
錯誤：廚師跳舞不是這句話要表達的內容。
錯誤：解讀成食物很多，意思相反。
questions.cue: there ain’t no luck（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）

pattern.text: 名詞（非標準／口語雙重否定）

questions.explanation: 正確：口語雙重否定在此表示完全沒有食物。

questions.word: if + 現在式，can + 原形動詞
questions.meaning: 若條件成立，就有能力或機會做某件事。
questions.usage: 談現實中有可能發生的選擇和結果時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: If you give me the key, I can open the gate, but the gate has no lock and cannot open.
If the train comes, we can get on it, but there is no train or track in this town.
If the rain stops, we can go outside, but outside does not exist.
If we get enough wood, we can build a small table.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：沒有鎖且不能打開的閘門，鑰匙不構成有用條件。
錯誤：地方沒有火車及鐵路，條件脫離情境。
錯誤：沒有「外面」這個地方，結果無法成立。
正確：木材充足是做小桌子的可行條件。
questions.cue: if you give me just one more try（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：木材充足是做小桌子的可行條件。

questions.word: a place + where + 主詞 + 動詞
questions.meaning: 用 where 子句補充說明地點的特色。
questions.usage: 辨認某個地方，補充那裡發生甚麼時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: This is a place where people can swim, but it is a dry room with no water and swimming is impossible.
This is a place where birds nest, but no birds have ever lived here and there are no nests.
We found a place where children can paint on the walls; it is an art room made for that.
We found a place where the sun shines, but the place is always under the ground with no sunlight at all.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：沒有水又禁止或無法游泳，與地點特色矛盾。
錯誤：沒有鳥和巢，無法支持築巢的描述。
正確：where 子句描述特別為畫牆而設的房間。
錯誤：完全沒有陽光，與陽光照射的描述相反。
questions.cue: a place where the sun still shines（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：where 子句描述特別為畫牆而設的房間。

questions.word: don’t you + 原形動詞（加強祈使語氣）
questions.meaning: 帶強烈情緒的否定命令；歌詞另有非標準 no wrong 雙重否定。
questions.usage: 理解帶感情的呼籲；課堂正式書寫宜用 Don’t + 動詞 + 受詞。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型及其功能？
options: Don’t you run into the road! Go and run there now.
Don’t you touch that hot pan! The pan is cold and safe, so I am telling you to touch it.
Don’t you open that box! Please open it straight away.
Don’t you step on the wet paint! It has not dried yet.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：禁止跑進馬路與要求跑進去相反。
錯誤：警告別碰，卻又立即叫對方碰。
錯誤：要求不要開盒，隨即要求開盒。
正確：油漆未乾，語氣強烈地提醒不要踩。
questions.cue: don’t you do me no wrong（來源：歌詞第 2–3 頁）
questions.explanation: 正確：油漆未乾，語氣強烈地提醒不要踩。
